title: Customers reporting counterfeit items received
situation: Multiple reports of counterfeit goods require immediate intervention to prevent further brand damage and potential safety concerns.

params.note: Multiple reports of counterfeit items received. Investigating product authenticity.

actions.why: Counterfeit claims require a security and quality investigation before issuing refunds.

params.reply_en: We are sorry to hear about the quality of your item. We have escalated this to our security team to investigate the authenticity of this batch immediately. We will contact you with a resolution shortly.
params.reply_ar: نعتذر عن استلامك منتجاً لا يطابق المواصفات. لقد قمنا بتحويل طلبك لفريق الجودة والأمان للتحقق من صحة المنتج، وسنتواصل معك فوراً بالحل المناسب.

actions.why: Acknowledge the issue and set expectations while the investigation is underway.

reply_en: We are sorry to hear about the quality of your item. We have escalated this to our security team to investigate the authenticity of this batch immediately. We will contact you with a resolution shortly.
reply_ar: نعتذر عن استلامك منتجاً لا يطابق المواصفات. لقد قمنا بتحويل طلبك لفريق الجودة والأمان للتحقق من صحة المنتج، وسنتواصل معك فوراً بالحل المناسب.

reply_other.es: Lamentamos saber que la calidad de su artículo no es la esperada. Hemos escalado este caso a nuestro equipo de seguridad para investigar la autenticidad de este lote de inmediato. Nos pondremos en contacto con usted con una resolución en breve.

alternatives.why: Could be a genuine quality control failure rather than intentional counterfeiting.
Possible picking error resulting in a lower-tier product being shipped.
